description_en: Deletes the control plane record of a specified workspace. The server completes the state transition from Deleting to Deleted within the same transaction. When you repeatedly delete a workspace that is in the Deleting or Deleted state, the server handles the request with idempotence semantics
description_zh: 删除指定工作空间控制面记录。服务端在同一事务内完成 Deleting 到 Deleted 的状态转换。重复删除处于 Deleting 或 Deleted 状态的工作空间时，服务端按幂等语义处理
name: DeleteWorkspace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to delete
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id
